streaming.large_history_policy: append-only spools plus current bounded record and compact decision reducers

source_bindings.administrative_drift: None substituted; all declared digests matched live and published authority bytes before output creation.

repair_coverage.S4V-01: Load locally trusted, independently source-pinned canonical queue and review-plan validators; validate every task in the admitted and claimed queues; require nested inline/path plan equality; freeze the complete claimed review declaration except state/lease; bind each handoff digest to the attested digest and reviewed blob; retain exact claim/release/archive ancestry and hashes.
repair_coverage.S4V-02: Stream every canonical artifact directly into an owned staging file while incrementally hashing and writing bounded fragments; keep large cells, certificates and diagnostics in append-only spools and retain only compact reducers in memory.
repair_coverage.S4V-03: Use custody.finalize_run in production and fixed tests; publish the payload durably, close its timing boundary, then publish runtime-custody/<run_id>/operational-completion.json durably; quarantine a payload after companion failure and preserve the primary typed stop with secondary custody failures.
repair_coverage.S4V-04: Construct and retain all seven assignments and bucket counts, reduce occupancy once, and stop with zero null censuses on failure; only then run the seven frozen null censuses.

future_operational_custody.payload_timing_boundary: Starts with the future runner and ends after the canonical payload rename and runs-directory fsync.
future_operational_custody.receipt_rule: The receipt is written, renamed and fsynced after the measured payload boundary; it excludes its own duration and has no self-hash.
future_operational_custody.failure_retention: A companion failure quarantines the published payload or leaves an explicit incomplete marker; the original typed stop carries every secondary custody failure.
future_operational_custody.cleanup_rule: Temporary progress is removed only after both durable payload and durable operational companion exist.

progress_bound.certificate_budget_effect: Scientific certificates use a separate append-only spool and do not consume progress events.
progress_bound.derivation: The 192 cells are 4 curves times 16 seeds times 3 coordinate scales. floor(268435456/1024)=262144 is only a safe progress stop; neither that cap nor the separate 781824 certificate-record bound guarantees full-panel completion.
progress_bound.cadence_scope: Signal flags are checked at every existing guarded opportunity; process-group RSS sampling is at most 250 ms apart between eligible opportunities and is not a real-time scheduling guarantee.

fixed_regression_scope.allowed: Lower-level fixed static, arithmetic, synthetic, mock, temporary-Git, telemetry-parser and temporary-artifact helpers, including the actual production finalizer.
forbidden_and_not_invoked: scientific null, control or timing panel
future-run, prospective pipeline or measurement CLI
real key, signature, nonce, lock, allocation, RUN directory or scientific artifact

future_admission_boundary.remaining_gate: Coordinator snapshots exactly these eight TASK-20260908-e34baf artifacts under TASK-20260908-9ef3ea, then a fresh independent complete source review validates that snapshot before any implementation or launch admission.

executor_inference.provenance: The committed handoff explicitly requested research-deep on native gpt-5.6-sol at xhigh. No serving probe was performed, so no served model identity is claimed.
